welcome.title: Welcome to {server}!
welcome.message:
Hey {mention}, we're happy to have you here! 🎉
You are member **#{member_count}**. Check out the rules and grab some roles.

role_menu.title: Pick your roles
role_menu.description: Click a button to get a role. Click it again to remove it.

entries.answer: 📜 **Server rules:** be respectful, no spam, keep chats on-topic, and no NSFW. Full details are pinned in #faq.
👋 To join in, grab your roles in #roles, then say hi in #general!
🎭 Head to #roles and click a button to add a role. Click it again to remove it.
📅 Want to hear about events? Pick the 📢 **Announcements** role in #roles and you'll be pinged when one is posted.
🛡️ Need help or want to report something? Mention a moderator or send a staff member a DM and we'll sort it out.
🤖 Type **/** to see everything I can do, like /serverinfo, /userinfo and /poll.
🔗 Right-click the server name, choose **Invite People**, and share the link with your friends!
🚫 Self-promotion and ads aren't allowed. Please check with a moderator first.
